message:
v1.0.3

Patch: identical content to v1.0.2 (matchConditions fix, issue 08) --
v1.0.2's underlying commit was accidentally SSH-signed (this shell's
global commit-signing default), which Flux's go-git library fails to
resolve during its shallow-fetch-by-tag path (confirmed: plain `git
clone --branch v1.0.2` works fine, only Flux's source-controller failed
with "unable to resolve commit object ... object not found").
v1.0.2 stays as an honest record of the mistake (tag-immutability ruleset
blocks moving it regardless, same pattern as v1.0.0/v2.0.0 before it).
v1.0.3's commit is unsigned (avoids the go-git issue); the tag itself is
fully gitsign-signed, same as every other release.
